title: Siding demo, reinstall, and color-match paint
scopeNotes: Demo is ONE lump: existing siding (450 sq ft), chimney section (~25 ft height), and all 13 window trims. Not split per surface.
The $1,000 demo figure is hard cost only. Standard profit margin is applied on top — not a pass-through.
Dump/disposal is a separate hauling fee, not part of the $1,000 demo labor.
Chimney material takeoff uses 25 ft height × 8 ft assumed wrap girth = 200 sq ft (3-side wrap on a typical 3–4 ft chimney).
Reinstall and paint on the house wall are 450 sq ft. Chimney reinstall is the 200 sq ft wrap at the height-premium labor rate.
Does not include dry-rot/sheathing repair, housewrap, flashing upgrades, scaffolding rental as a separate line, permits, or lead testing.
